purpose: Replace the memoryless switching penalty by a learned age-dependent exit cost, aiming to recover brief possessions without lowering every switch penalty.
training: Only clean training-game duration histograms; H/A pooled for symmetry, dead separate; 2-frame Gaussian smoothing, 20-risk pseudo prior, 50-frame explicit ages then geometric overflow; log hazard ratio clipped +-2; positive cost floor .05.
selection: Highest selection spellF1 with macro>=baseline-.002; freeze then evaluate selected only on fold2; adopt if both game means improve and macro>=baseline-.002.
limitation: Historically used matches, repeated development selection, not untouched final test.
